title: ChangesReport
description:
What `ddc changes --json` prints. Its own optional fields are always
written, as null when absent; a row's (`trashed_in`, `moved_from`,
`harness`, `approximate`) are left out when absent.

cleaned_since.description:
The person's own cleans between the two saves that named a finding of
the baseline, from the action journal.

compared_roots.description:
The roots both reports read: the reports' own when equal, else the
inner of two nested roots. Empty when not compared.

disk.description:
In-use space on the home folder's volume. Null when not compared, or
when either report lacks that volume.

grew.description:
In-use space on the home folder's volume grew by at least
max(20 GiB, 5 % of its total) between the two reports: the rule of
`ddc space`'s `grew` (ADR "Menu bar app: Swift shell over the ddc
CLI" §6 item 13). False when not compared or without `disk`.

groups.description:
One entry per Review group with a compared change, biggest growth
first.

items.description: Every finding that changed, biggest change first.

reason.description: Why the two reports were not compared; null when they were.

before_at.description:
RFC 3339: when each report read the free space, the volume's
`read_at`, else the report's `generated_at`.

before_in_use.description: Total minus free bytes in the baseline.

delta.description: `now_in_use - before_in_use`: positive when in-use space grew.

by_harness.description: The part in each coding agent's worktrees or data.

delta.description:
The net change, the person's cleans and the Trash's intake from them
left out.

group.description:
The Review group's label, as `ddc rules --json` gives it; "Other" for
a rule in no group.

Home.description: The scanned folders as a whole.

compared.description:
Both reports read the same folders the same way, so their totals
compare.

delta.description: `totals.scanned_bytes` now minus before; null when not compared.

elsewhere.description:
What `delta` leaves after the compared findings: growth in folders
that are no finding, and findings not compared. Null when not
compared.

ignored_delta.description:
The change of the ignored findings (types switched off), which the
groups leave out.

oneOf.description: One scan had Full Disk Access and the other not.
A report's `skipped` or `inaccessible` list was cut short.
The reports did not read the same folders, `changed` ones apart.

approximate.description:
Either side shares some of its bytes with other files (clones, hard
links): its size is an upper bound.

before.description: Allocated bytes in each report; null on the side without it.

cleaned.description: The bytes of it the person's cleans removed.

delta.description: `now - before`, a missing side counting as 0.

harness.description: The coding agent whose worktree or data it is.

ignored.description: Ignored in the current report (or the baseline, when gone).

moved_from.description: For a `moved` row: the path in the baseline.

trashed_in.description: For the Trash: the growth that is the person's trashed items.

oneOf.description: Gone or shrunk by the person's own cleans, wholly.
Gone at one path and new at another with the same identity and rule.
One report did not read where it lies, or lacked its rule.

NotReadKind.description: Why a folder was not read, which picks its label and action.

oneOf.description: A cloud folder, never read.
A folder the person skips (`skips` in `settings.json`, `--skip`).

A folder macOS asks before reading, left out of a scan without Full
Disk Access.
A folder the system refused to list.
A folder whose files are in the cloud only.
Another disk mounted inside a root.
A file system snapshot (Linux).
A folder that changed while the walk listed it.
A git worktree, whoever made it.

Reason.description:
Why two reports were not compared. When several hold, the first in this
order is given.

oneOf.description: No `last-scan.json`.
No `previous-scan.json`.
A report that does not decode with this version's types.

A report without `written_at` or `rules_in_force`: saved before
version 0.31.
A report of a cancelled scan.
No root of one report lies at or inside a root of the other.
`last-scan.json` does not name `previous-scan.json` as its pair.

Rest.description: What the disk's change leaves after the scanned folders.

delta.description:
The disk's `delta` minus the home's `delta` (or, when the home does
not compare, minus the compared findings' change). Null without a
disk.

not_read.description: What the current report did not read.

Side.description: One report, as the output names it.

WrittenBy.description:
Which save wrote a report (ADR "Menu bar app: Swift shell over the ddc
CLI", §6 item 14). `scan`, `background` and `clean-recheck` keep the
report they replace in `previous-scan.json` when it is whole; the others
leave that file as it is. A new value bumps `SCHEMA_VERSION`.

oneOf.description: `ddc scan`.
`ddc scan --background`, the scheduled scan.
A terminal `ddc clean`'s re-check, saved before anything is removed.
A terminal `ddc clean`'s re-check, edited by what the clean did.
`ddc clean --items`, edited by what the clean did.
`ddc disk free`, after a tool cleaned the Homebrew cache.
